Warehouse Executive Job at CIG Motors Company Limited




        
    

        
        CIG Motors Company Limited is one of the African subsidiaries of Choice International Group. We are the exclusive premiere representative of leading Chinese automotive giants, including GAC Motors, JMC Motors, Dongfeng Motors, FAW Group, and Wuling Motors, within the Nigeria and Africa market. 

CIG have consistently expanded our market presence nationwide through strategic partnerships and alliances, delivering a portfolio of high-quality and premium vehicles into the African market. We prioritize customer satisfaction and strive to exceed expectations. Our dedication to quality, innovation, and growth remains unwavering as we continue to shape the automotive industry landscape in Nigeria and beyond.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Warehouse Executive

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Warehouse Executive is responsible for ensuring efficient handling, storage, and dispatch of automobile spare parts.
	This role involves maintaining inventory accuracy, supporting smooth supply chain operations, and upholding safety and quality standards within the warehouse.


Key Responsibilities
Receiving and Inspection:


	Receive and inspect incoming spare parts for accuracy, quantity, and quality.
	Report any discrepancies or damages promptly to the supervisor.


Storage and Organization:


	Organize and store spare parts in an orderly, labeled, and accessible manner.
	Ensure proper stacking and categorization based on part type and usage.


Inventory Management:


	Maintain accurate inventory records using Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
	Conduct regular stock counts and cycle counts to ensure data accuracy.


Dispatch and Delivery:


	Coordinate the picking, packing, and dispatch of spare parts to service teams, branches, or customers.
	Ensure timely and accurate delivery of parts.


Warehouse Maintenance:


	Maintain a clean, safe, and organized warehouse environment.
	Ensure all activities comply with safety, health, and environmental regulations.


Reporting and Documentation:


	Prepare and submit reports on stock levels, damages, delivery status, and stock movements.
	Keep records of all warehouse transactions and documentation.


Team Collaboration:


	Work closely with procurement, and logistics teams to ensure timely parts availability.
	Assist in training and guiding junior warehouse staff if needed.


Requirements
Qualifications and Skills: 


	Education: Bachelor's Degree in Logistics, Business Administration, or related field.
	Experience: Minimum 2 years in warehouse operations, preferably in the automotive industry.


Skills:


	Knowledge of spare parts handling and inventory control
	Proficiency in WMS or ERP systems
	Strong organizational and time-management skills
	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
	Basic computer skills (Excel, email, etc.)
	Physical ability to lift and move inventory items safely

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

	The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing financial records, ensuring accuracy in reporting, and supporting day-to-day accounting operations.


Responsibilities


	Prepare and maintain accurate financial records
	Handle accounts payable and receivable
	Perform bank reconciliations
	Assist in payroll preparation
	Generate financial reports and support audits
	Ensure compliance with financial regulations.


Requirements


	B.Sc. in Accounting or a related field
	2 – 4 years of relevant accounting experience
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
	Familiarity with accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, Sage, etc.)
	Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.


Salary
N200,000 - N220,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Accountant Lekki" as the subject of the email.
